DATA SOURCE

Connect your robot

Connect to your MQTT broker's WebSocket listener. Your Pico and this dashboard must use the same topics.

The firmware supplies actual distance, line IR (GP27/GP26), IMU, wheel feedback and scans. Missing producer data stays unavailable. STATUS is read-only. Stop sets the controller inhibit; Resume explicitly releases it after fresh readiness checks and may restart autonomous movement. Stationary builds keep wheel PWM disabled and reject Resume.

Telemetry format: Packed v4 (46-byte measurements, scan chunks and diagnostics).

Broker authentication optional

Credentials stay in this tab's memory and are cleared when settings close. They are never saved or exported.

Using a private ws:// broker? Run the dashboard locally. A hosted HTTPS page needs a reachable wss:// broker and browser network access.
